The '''Tythos River''' was a [[river]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], near the [[Tythos Ridge]] mountain range. Starting from a waterfall near the ruins of the temple-cities of [[Kaleth]] and [[Vur Tepe]], the river wound its way through several mountains and valleys and past the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] before it reached the [[Tythonian Gnarls]], where it spread into several small tributaries that later rejoined at the far end of the area.
